note.value: NDMA counts run 14 June to 18 Nov 2022; the PDNA (Oct 2022) used 94 calamity-hit districts as of 11 Oct, the NDMA SITREP table lists 90 notified districts.

emdat.units: events = count; deaths/affected = people; damage_usd_adj = sum of the 'Total Damage (USD, adjusted)' column as published (CPI-adjusted USD); blank cells count as 0, so totals are lower bounds

production.label: Industry
production.def: Workforce in mining, manufacturing, utilities & construction (Economic Census 2023, PSIC B–F)

gold.label: Economy
gold.def: MODELLED GDP, PPP, 2024 (Kummu et al. gridded GDP) — not official district accounts

trade.label: Trade
trade.def: Workforce in wholesale & retail, transport, hotels (Economic Census 2023, PSIC G–I)

science.label: Knowledge
science.def: Workforce in ICT, finance, professional/scientific services & education (Economic Census 2023, PSIC J, K, M, P)

culture.label: Culture
culture.def: Workforce in arts, entertainment & recreation (Economic Census 2023, PSIC R)

lenses.label: Terrain
lenses.desc: Painted terrain from elevation + land cover.

lenses.label: Elevation
lenses.desc: Mean elevation of each hex, Arabian Sea coast to the Karakoram.

lenses.label: Farmland
lenses.desc: Share of each hex mapped as cropland (ESA WorldCover 2021).

lenses.label: Forest
lenses.desc: Share of tree cover (ESA WorldCover 2021). Pakistan is ~5% forested.

lenses.label: Desert & bare
lenses.desc: Share of bare / sparse ground (ESA WorldCover 2021).

lenses.label: Snow & glacier
lenses.desc: Permanent snow & ice (ESA WorldCover 2021) — the Indus water towers.

lenses.label: Built-up
lenses.desc: Share of built-up land (ESA WorldCover 2021).

lenses.label: Population density
lenses.desc: WorldPop 2025 grid rescaled to each district's Census 2023 total (AJK & GB: WorldPop only).

lenses.label: Growth 2017→23
lenses.desc: Average annual population growth between the 2017 and 2023 censuses.

lenses.label: Urban share
lenses.desc: Share of residents in urban areas (Census 2023).

lenses.label: Household size
lenses.desc: Average persons per household (Census 2023).

lenses.label: Mother tongue
lenses.desc: Most common mother tongue in each district (Census 2023, Table 11).

lenses.label: Linguistic diversity
lenses.desc: Chance two random residents have different mother tongues (1 − Herfindahl of Table 11 shares).

lenses.label: Religious minorities
lenses.desc: Share of residents who are not Muslim (Census 2023, Table 9): Hindus in Tharparkar & Umerkot, Christians in Punjab.

lenses.label: Largest minority
lenses.desc: The largest non-Muslim community in each district (Census 2023, Table 9).

lenses.label: Literacy
lenses.desc: Literacy rate, population aged 10+ (Census 2023, Table 12).

lenses.label: Literacy gender gap
lenses.desc: Male minus female literacy, percentage points (Census 2023).

lenses.label: Poverty (MPI)
lenses.desc: Multidimensional poverty headcount (PSLM 2019-20; MPI report, UNDP/OPHI/Planning Commission).

lenses.label: Economy (modelled GDP)
lenses.desc: MODELLED GDP 2024 (Kummu et al., gridded) — a model, not official district accounts.

lenses.label: GDP per person (modelled)
lenses.desc: Modelled GDP ÷ population. Indicative only.

lenses.label: Manufacturing jobs
lenses.desc: Location quotient of manufacturing workforce (Economic Census 2023). >1 = more specialised than Pakistan.

lenses.label: Dominant crop
lenses.desc: Crop with the largest cropped area (Agricultural Census 2024).

lenses.label: 2022 mega-flood
lenses.desc: Share of each hex under water in UNOSAT's VIIRS cumulative extent, 1 Jul – 31 Aug 2022. Caveat: the composite also catches deliberately flooded rice paddies in the Punjab rice belt (Sialkot–Gujranwala).

lenses.label: Seismicity
lenses.desc: Energy released by M4.5+ earthquakes since 1902 (USGS ComCat), smoothed over neighbouring hexes.
